messages:
mira: Quick shoutout  Nova Insurance signed a 24-month Dedicated renewal and we published their Oracle Cloud Marketplace listing this morning. Listing: https://cloudmarketplace.oracle.com/listings/nova-redwood. Huge for regulated finance/insurance customers. :tada:

oracle-marketplace-bot: Oracle Cloud Marketplace listing published (Offer ID: NOVA-RW-2026). Private Offer available  PO ID: ORA-PO-991122.

vincent: Renewal highlights: 8 reserved GPUs, EKM/HSM integration, 99.95% SLA, and a 25% committed discount. They plan phased migration of claims pipelines over the next 8 weeks.

julia: Legal approved the case study copy and the public quote. Nova signed off on data residency and audit language for APAC and EMEA nodes.

eng-runtime: Onboarding note: Nova requested per-tenant KV-cache presets and a recommended quantization profile for their transformer models. We'll prepare the runbook and a tuning session next week.

mira: Marketing: can you queue a blog + social push? We'd like to highlight "Predictable cost during peak claims cycles" and the Private Offer path.

marketing-bot: Draft blog and social snippets saved in CMS. Assigned to julia for final approval (due: 2026-06-03).

legal: Final quote approved: "Redwood gave us predictable, compliant inference at scale and reduced our peak costs." Nova ok'd this.

vincent: Early marketplace telemetry: 14 listing views, 4 private-offer inquiries, 1 trial activation. Good start.

mira: Thanks team  please DM me if any assets or quote tweaks needed. Planning a joint webinar with Nova ENG later this month to demo the migration flow. :rocket:
